note: The plans Egma Cloud sells, and the one-time welcome credit every
organization receives. Written into cloud_plan on boot, the way the rate
card is written into rate_card, so a price change is a row change and not
Money is in millionths of a US dollar, the unit every amount in this
product is counted in: $50.00 is 50000000, $0.05 is 50000.
An allowance of null is unlimited. Zero would mean none at all, which is
the opposite, so the absence is written as an absence.
The two Pro overage prices are placeholders confirmed as placeholders by
the founder on 2026-09-07: $0.05 a phone minute and $0.01 a web-call
minute, until they are set. Hobby has no overage — it pauses — so its two
prices are zero and nothing reads them.
